acceptance_criteria: Code search runs through agent-map HybridSearch when the derived chunk index is usable, and falls back to AgentMapIndex::query() otherwise.
A hybrid result set renders only agent-map's own mode, degraded reason, structural terms, per-channel ranks and both snapshots.

The fallback result set is attributed to agent-ui, labels its own mode and reason as agent-ui labels, and reports absent channel ranks, structural terms and search-index snapshot as absent instead of synthesizing owner-shaped values.
Source windows are bounded and hash-verified through agent-map SourceMaterializer before any line is rendered.

A refused source window is classified from AgentMapIndex::staleEntries(): a file agent-map names stale renders as stale with the owner reason, and any other materialization failure stays distinguishable as unavailable.
A symbol projects agent-map's bounded reverse-dependency impact with depth, relation kinds, truncation and uncertainty preserved, drawn and also listed as text.
All new pages are server-rendered and useful without JavaScript.
composer ci is green on the exact implementation head.
goal: Turn the agent-ui Code Map into a code search, verified source reading and impact visualization surface by consuming agent-map's typed hybrid search, source materialization and impact analysis, so that every rendered claim is either produced by the semantic owner or explicitly attributed to agent-ui.
non_goals: No new framework, build step or client-side asset pipeline.
No second search index, chunker, ranking policy, source reader or architecture model inside the UI.
No host-integration or .claude/ managed-asset changes; those belong to their own branch and Contract.
No semantic channel until agent-map exposes a typed factory for restoring its embedding provider.
